children: Bowling-alley operator Lucky Strike Entertainment wants to revamp its menu, and is turning to a former casino executive to help. The company says it has appointed Patrick Chung as executive vice president of food & beverage operations. Chung previously oversaw food and beverage strategy at MGM Resorts International, and will be tasked at Lucky Strike with improving the company's food and beverage experience based on guest feedback. "Food and beverage should be a reason guests choose Lucky Strike, not simply something they order once they arrive," Chief Executive Thomas Shannon said. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
